commands.command: focused Unit profile scope, runtime state/fence, runtime lease, and composition filter

sourceAssertions: All public LLM Chat application interfaces resolve to internal profile-scoped decorators.
The conversation engine reuses an existing outer operation scope instead of reacquiring current identity.
Every root EF LLM Chat transaction commits through ILlmChatCommitFence.
DatabaseRuntimeState total-orders profile-switch publication and fenced transaction commits.
Lease acquisition captures ICanonicalRuntimeDatabase identity and rejects a changed runtime state.
No production partial expansion or project-reference change was introduced.
behavioralCases: capture before first public application read
stale identity rejected before entering a durable write
provider audit and usage retained when switch rejects finalization
stale host rejects later public reads and writes
negativeCases: pre-SB03 public query succeeds without ever acquiring a lease
profile switch between provider return and finalization cannot commit an assistant result
old-root lease acquisition cannot adopt the newly selected profile identity
caller cancellation is not mislabeled as profile invalidation

acceptance.criterion: Every public LLM Chat application operation captures profile identity before its first read.
acceptance.evidence: All three public application interfaces are registered through the scope runner; the exact pre/post public query regression proves acquisition ordering.

acceptance.criterion: All repositories, provider resolution, transcript commands, and audit writes use the captured operation scope.
acceptance.evidence: The runner pushes one ambient execution context, the engine reuses it, and the existing profile-fenced transcript/provider/audit adapters consume it.

acceptance.criterion: A profile switch prevents every subsequent old-generation durable commit.
acceptance.evidence: DatabaseRuntimeState serializes switch publication with ILlmChatCommitFence; focused ordering and real PostgreSQL finalization tests pass.

acceptance.criterion: A switch during provider execution yields deterministic non-success or RecoveryRequired with retained usage evidence.
acceptance.evidence: Real-host PostgreSQL test returns typed RuntimeProfileChanged, retains successful invocation audit/usage, leaves the active turn recoverable, and commits no assistant.

acceptance.criterion: No current-profile DbContext or provider lease is cached across operations.
acceptance.evidence: Scoped DbContext/UoW/engine are created per request scope; singleton factories/resolvers retain only immutable host-root dependencies and create a fresh operation lease/provider resolution per call.
